tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search the allMCPservers directory of MCP servers from the Official MCP Registry and Claude's Connectors Directory. Returns matching servers with their slug, publisher, category, transport and profile link. Leave out query to browse, editor's picks first.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: One server's full profile: description, remote endpoint or package to install, required headers and environment variables, repository, documentation and the official listings it comes from.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The directory's categories with how many servers each has.

tools.name: compare_mcp_servers
tools.description: Two to four servers side by side: transport, endpoint or package, authentication, version, last update and official listings.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_mcp_server" references sensitive artifacts (environment variable). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
